svg.title: How nocturnum fits together
svg.desc: An embedding model turns text or images into vectors for scripts and agents, which send them with JSON payloads to the REST API of the one nocturnum binary on port 6333, which also serves the web console to a browser and health and metrics to Prometheus, while each collection's data directory holds a write-ahead log, a memtable in RAM flushed to a segment after 32 MiB of writes, and segments with vectors, payloads and HNSW graphs, with snapshots kept in a separate directory.
